description: English candidate: all exposed v3 cases as unchanged regressions and a new frozen independent holdout.
pass_definition: A row must satisfy both evidence checks of actual retrieval, citations, tool execution and definitions and the fixed native business judge.
judge_calibration: Every synthetic correct/incorrect control must match its expected verdict. Keep controls separate from target responses.

human_review.note: Human review is recommended in the guide before production use but is not a completion requirement for this educational automated gate.
